output.response_text: I used to believe that fully remote work was non-negotiable, as I prized uninterrupted focus and the freedom to arrange my day without office oversight. I now prefer a hybrid model—three days in person per week—balancing solitude for deep work with human interaction to maintain energy and judgment. The change in my thinking came from recognizing that isolation has a real cost to my mental and emotional well-being, even though freedom still matters.
